replay_idempotency.note: Dedupe identity (scope_partition, event_type, idempotency_key) plus producer digest: an exact retry returns the original event and result, a changed digest is idempotency_conflict and never appends. (PNC-019 S2 regrade, reports/event-authority-20261114/s2-depth-post-august.json.)
